calculation_handling.description: Amending instruction of By-law 1075-2026, section 32: adds new regulation 150.7.75.1(2) to Zoning By-law 569-2013.
calculation_handling.gaps: Enactment instruction only; no regulatory content.

calculation_handling.description: A heating, ventilation and air conditioning device associated with a garden suite, whether on the garden suite building or ground mounted, may encroach up to 0.9 m into a required building setback or required separation distance if no closer than 0.3 m to a lot line; on the building it may sit on the roof and exceed the height limit by 2.0 m or on a platform; ground mounted it must be within 2.0 m of a main wall or a platform.
calculation_handling.gaps: Only the setback encroachment arms ((A)(i), (B)(i)) are expressed. The separation-distance encroachment arms ((A)(ii), (B)(ii)) have no DSL target (encroachment_m is into a setback), the 2.0 m rooftop height projection has no target, and the 2.0 m placement from a main wall or platform has no variable, so those literals are listed as not expressed. Mixed targets (encroachment_m max, encroachment_clearance_m min) in one unit. The subject is an HVAC device, which has no vocab building type or use; keyed to garden_suite as its host.

units.disclosure: Garden suite heat pumps and air conditioners may project up to 0.9 m into setbacks and separation distances (staying 0.3 m from lot lines), up to 2.0 m above the roof, and must be within 2.0 m of a wall or platform if on the ground; not evaluated.

150.7.75.1(2)@1075-2026.explanation: Heating, ventilation and air conditioning equipment serving a garden suite may project up to 0.9 m into required setbacks and separation distances if it stays at least 0.3 m from lot lines, may sit on the suite's roof up to 2.0 m above its height limit or on a platform, and if ground-mounted must be within 2.0 m of a main wall or platform.
